scope: Source-path errata and current bound-predicate provenance for four Azure cohorts; original reports unchanged.
method: AST indexes exact whole decorated function bodies, independently checks retained body digests, and resolves current registry source/path/line from the same inspect.unwrap result. Registry wrapper code paths are recorded separately.
limitation: Exact source-body match establishes byte provenance, not native API correctness or test coverage. Changed bodies need their separate authorized successor receipts; no historical hash is refreshed here.
